en.title: How analytics can support dissemination reporting
en.lead: Using web analytics to produce credible, useful evidence for communication and dissemination KPIs.

sections.heading: Tie metrics to objectives
paragraphs: Generic traffic numbers rarely satisfy a project officer. Tie metrics directly to the communication and dissemination objectives in the proposal, and report against them consistently.

en.note: This article is about measuring an EU project’s website. techpi.eu itself uses no analytics or tracking: see the [Cookies Policy](/cookies).

meta.title: How analytics can support dissemination reporting | TechPi
meta.description: Using web analytics to produce credible evidence for EU project communication and dissemination KPIs, tied to the objectives set out in the proposal.
